english.title: Dispose of weighing / measuring equipment after revocation of approval certificate without informing recipient
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing that the certificate of approval in respect of a pattern of

(A)_[weighing]_
(B)_[measuring]_

equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE EQUIPMENT..), had been revoked other than in a case falling within section 12(11)(b) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985, disposed of it to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), in a state in which it could be used for trade without informing

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_

of the revocation
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 13(3)(c) and 84(1) and (2) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985.

english.notes:
(i) Section 13(3) of the of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that the any equipment in respect of which the offence was committed shall be liable to be forfeited.
(ii) Section 83(1) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that In England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.
